title: Kissed Crispy British Steak Welsh Rarebit
description: A rich and indulgent British dish featuring crispy fillet of steak, served with a creamy Welsh rarebit sauce, perfect for a special occasion dinner.
instructions: Season the beef fillet with salt and black pepper.
Heat the butter in a pan over high heat and sear the beef fillet for 2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the beef fillet to a pressure cooker and cook for 10 minutes.
In a saucepan, melt 20g of butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly add the milk, whisking continuously, and bring to a simmer.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the grated cheese until melted.
Add the worcestershire sauce and dijon mustard to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
Slice the cooked beef fillet into thin strips.
Serve the beef strips topped with the Welsh rarebit sauce.
